description: Use this to delete one of the user's saved Sidekick actions. Deleting cannot be undone from Sidekick, so always ask the user to confirm first, naming the action. Built-in actions and actions in a shared folder cannot be deleted, nor can a locked (read-only) file; deleting a saved action that replaced a built-in or a shared one brings that one back.

name.description: The action's name, as list_actions gives it

name: delete_action
